headline: AE Industrial Closes Purchase of L3Harris’s Space Propulsion, Power and Electronics Units Establishing the Business as Rocketdyne
summary: BOCA RATON, Fla., August 04, 2026--AE Industrial Partners, LP ("AE Industrial" or the "Firm"), a private investment firm focused on technologies and services critical to national and economic security, has finalized the acquisition of the space propulsion, power and electronics units from L3Harris Technologies ("L3Harris"), and is launching the entity as Rocketdyne (the "Company"). L3Harris will retain a minority stake in the business and continue to be a strategic partner.
